Hi Jason — looping in a short cost summary and migration notes inline, and the attached pricing workbook has the detailed committed/overage rows you asked for. Highlights: 

Short cost summary (high level):
- Hosted API (pay-as-you-go): Best for quick pilot and minimal ops. Example: $0.0008 per token for our recommended 7B model profile for chat-heavy workloads. No commit required; variable month-to-month.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): Best for predictable QPS/latency and lower unit cost at scale. Example: 1x Dedicated pool (4x A100-equivalent instances) reserved = ~$80k/month committed. Effective per-token cost depends on utilization; at 60% utilization the blended per-token is ~ $0.00035. Overages billed at a higher per-token rate or extra on-demand capacity.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): For EU residency and strict controls. Pricing = base platform fee + infra pass-through + professional services for deployment. Typical entry: $150k one-time setup + $50k/month for managed control plane (numbers vary by infra).

Committed pricing examples (see workbook): we included 6- and 12-month step-downs (5% off at 6m, 10% off at 12m) and a sample ramp schedule. For procurement, the "Redwood-Pricing-Calc-v2.xlsx" contains a template PO-friendly breakdown: commit lines, expected utilization, overage rates, and amortized setup.

Migration path (hosted -> dedicated -> private):
- Pilot on Hosted: quick onboarding, use same API keys and model pins. Collect token/latency profiles (we can provide instrumentation hooks).
- Transition to Dedicated: we reserve capacity and can migrate traffic with a canary rollout. KV/prefix caching config moves with model variant; expected cutover time 48–72 hours for warm-up.
- Private/VPC: control plane switch and networking setup; typically 4–8 weeks for customer-managed cloud networking and certs (shorter if infra already prepped).

Attachments: detailed workbook + SLA stub. Connor (CC) is our Solutions Architect — he can run a short TCO and latency projection with your infra numbers if helpful.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call — my availability Tue/Thu this week 10:00–13:00 PT.

Thanks,
